key_idea: Shooting the lattice (x+2y) mod 5 = c hits every length-5 ship, horizontal or vertical, exactly once using about n^2/5 <= 2000 shots; then finish each hit by shooting 4 cells in every direction.
sketch: Any 5 consecutive cells in a row cover all residues of x mod 5 and in a column all residues of 2y mod 5, so each ship has exactly one lattice cell. Scan the lattice (choose the residue class with fewest cells); on any hit immediately fire the up to 16 cells at distance 1..4 in the four directions, skipping out-of-grid and already shot cells. Total at most 2000 + 10*16 = 2160 <= 2500 regardless of the adaptive adversary. Exit as soon as the k-th 'sunk' is read and flush after every shot. Verified with a self-written local interactor (random placements, n in {5..100}, max 2092 shots); the project checker cannot judge interactive problems.
